summary.motive: Use split-flow action to punish aggressive horizontal pursuit and create a massive cutback alley behind a sealing H-back.
summary.whyItWorks: Offensive line stretch forces the front to flow laterally while the H-back slices across the grain to kick out the unblocked backside edge. Linebackers flowing with the line are sealed off, opening an explosive backside cutback crease.
summary.failureMode: A disciplined backside DE squeezing down the line to spill the H-back block, or interior DT penetration blowing up the mesh.

beats.title: Condensed 12P Alignment & Tight Splits
beats.text: Kubiak lines up in a condensed 12 personnel wing set. Tight WR splits compress the defensive front, creating favorable blocking angles on the perimeter.

beats.title: The Lateral Stretch & Split Flow
beats.text: The offensive line surges laterally to the right in zone synchronization. Simultaneously, H-Back (H) slices back across the grain, leaving backside WDE unblocked by design.

beats.title: Linebackers Commit to Run Flow
beats.text: The lateral stretch sucks Mike and Will linebackers hard toward the strongside B-gap, opening a massive natural cutback void behind them.

beats.title: The H-Back Slice Kickout & RB Cutback
beats.text: H delivers a crushing kickout block on the crashing WDE. The RB plants his playside foot, bends back against the grain, and explodes through the split-zone alley.

beats.title: Second-Level Explosion
beats.text: With the climbing Center pinning Mike and LT walling off Will, the RB bursts untouched into the secondary for an explosive chunk gain.

relations.tell: Base foundation call: H-Back slices across the formation to kick out the backside DE on true zone run.
